entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You read the letter, did you not?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: So you're the one who tipped him off[n]about Futaba.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You really shouldn't have done that.[n]I have no intention of talking to you[n]about Wakaba.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Tipped off...? What are you talking about?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Back to the matter at hand...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Your parental authority will have to be[n]suspended. I take it you're okay with[n]that outcome?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Considering the state of your daughter[n]and your family overall, there are no[n]points in your favor.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Would you like to take this to domestic[n]court? Our chances of victory are[n]roughly 99.9% though.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: With these suspicions of abuse... there's[n]no way you could avoid having your[n]custody revoked.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You're going that far!? I told you, I don't[n]know a damn thing about it.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We're extremely serious about this.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: As long as there's a possibility that[n]cognitive psience can be linked to[n]psychotic breakdowns...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Tch...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Fine... You win.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Thank you. I will contact you at[n]a later date.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I doubt you'll find anything you want to[n]hear though.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That's fine. It will be up to us to decide[n]whether the information you give us[n]is useful or not.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Next time I come here, it will just be[n]for a nice cup of coffee.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And stay out!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That woman is real good at pissing[n]people off...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...What's with that look? You got[n]something to say?
What was that?
Court?
Custody?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This doesn't involve you.
Where is Futaba?
Let me meet Futaba.
Is Futaba your daughter?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That's enough!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Just behave yourself and keep going to[n]school if you don't want me to throw you[n]out of here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You got that?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Lock the store up.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, that basically confirms Futaba[n]exists, at least. But it sounds like she's[n]got her own problems...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Moreso, our conjecture that Alibaba is[n]connected to Leblanc seems to have[n]a pretty solid foundation.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, and didn't they mention "cognitive"[n]something?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I wonder what the chief's hiding.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We can't really press him on the subject[n]though, especially after he mentioned[n]throwing you out.
